references.text: Describes the process by which Israel was to come forward tribe by tribe, explaining the context for verse 16 where Joshua actually carries this out.
Another biblical lot-casting procedure to identify the guilty, a similar method used by Joshua to find the sinner.
Samuel uses the same method of presenting the tribes of Israel to choose Saul as king, the same principle of selection tribe by tribe.
Saul uses lot casting to find out who had sinned, a similar process to reveal guilt as in Joshua 7.
The proverb speaks of lot casting as a way to decide matters, reflecting the divine guidance in Joshua's selection process.
Lots are cast to find out who is guilty of the storm, parallel to how Joshua identified Achan through a similar process.
